levels.bare: wild food only, eaten raw as gathered: no fields, no fire, no store
levels.standing: the fields as they are: one crop a year sown on unbroken ground, not weeded; grain boiled; kept in a house
levels.worked: the best crops and fallow the year allows; soil broken, weeded, manured where there are beasts; grain ground to meal; kept in bins
levels.best: everything the world's techniques reach: ploughing, full weeding, master farmers, seed selection, rye over the winter, milled flour and bread, a granary
levels.ceiling: best, and meadow, pasture, scrub and woods cleared to fields as far as the fuel the hearths need allows
